INSERT INTO mail_outbox (mail_outbox_id, company_id, user_account_id, email_verification_id, public_inquiry_id, public_reply_id, mail_type, recipient_email, subject, dedupe_key) VALUES (#{mailOutboxId}, #{companyId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userAccountId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{emailVerificationId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{publicInquiryId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{publicReplyId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{mailType}, #{recipientEmail}, #{subject}, #{dedupeKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_outbox SET status_code = #{status}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, sent_at = CASE WHEN #{success} = 'Y' THEN ELSE sent_at END, last_error = #{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = WHERE mail_outbox_id = #{mailOutboxId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_attempt (mail_outbox_id, attempt_no, success_yn, error_message, attempted_at) SELECT mail_outbox_id, attempt_count, #{success}, #{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FROM mail_outbox WHERE mail_outbox_id = #{mailOutboxId}
